ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated distally and 40% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated medially.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) regions occupy the lateral quadrants of both lobes. A low-intensity (black) axial region forms a wedge from the leading edge to the median notch. Low-intensity mottling and stippling are visible within the white regions, primarily concentrated along the transition to the black trailing edge border.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 35-40 degrees; vertex depth is significant, approximately 20% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrated boundary along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3 and 12 pixels, creating a jagged silhouette isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a strong convex curvature; trailing edge follows a generally horizontal trajectory with a slight downward dip toward the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular yellowish-white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) are detected at the distal terminal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biofouling (barnacle clusters) on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; several small, distinct notches or 'chips' in the pixel-boundary of the left lobe trailing edge.
